Cyclists Withdraw from World Championships After Training Crashes

Belgian cyclist Van Kerckhove and Canadian cyclist Derek Gee have withdrawn from the UCI Road World Championships following separate training crashes. Both athletes were forced to pull out of the competition due to injuries sustained in these incidents.
